v1.5.2 Update
- Choose the minimum Actor permission needed to see organization members: No permission required, LIMITED, OBSERVER, OWNER, or GM only. The default is LIMITED.
- Show member names and portraits without granting Actor sheet access. Existing hidden-member settings still apply.
- Fixed organization member lists not refreshing after Actor permission changes.

announcement.title: 💞 Stylish Relationship Tracker v1.5.2
announcement.content:
Organization Member Visibility

  • In an organization's edit form, open Visibility and choose Minimum permission to see members: No permission required, LIMITED, OBSERVER, OWNER, or GM only. The default is LIMITED.
  • The setting controls member names and portraits in the directory and organization map. Actor sheet, relationship record, and status tag access remain unchanged. Hidden organizations and members stay hidden.
  • Fixed organization member lists not refreshing after Actor permission changes.
